info.title: GitHub Actions artifact download between jobs

diffs.patch:
Index: .github/workflows/artifacts.yml
===================================================================
--- .github/workflows/artifacts.yml	
+++ .github/workflows/artifacts.yml	
@@ -0,0 +1,38 @@
+name: Build and Consume Artifact
+
+on:
+  push:
+  workflow_dispatch:
+
+jobs:
+  build:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
+
+      - name: Produce build output
+        run: |
+          mkdir -p dist
+          echo "build ${{ github.sha }}" > dist/build.txt
+
+      - name: Upload build artifact
+        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
+        with:
+          name: build-output
+          path: dist/
+          if-no-files-found: error
+
+  consume:
+    needs: build
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    steps:
+      - name: Download build artifact
+        uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8.0.1
+        with:
+          name: build-output
+          path: downloaded/
+
+      - name: Use the downloaded artifact
+        run: |
+          echo "Contents of downloaded artifact:"
+          cat downloaded/build.txt

input.content:
name: Build and Consume Artifact

on:
  push:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Produce build output
        run: |
          mkdir -p dist
          echo "build ${{ github.sha }}" > dist/build.txt

      - name: Upload build artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: build-output
          path: dist/
          if-no-files-found: error

  consume:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Download build artifact
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: build-output
          path: downloaded/

      - name: Use the downloaded artifact
        run: |
          echo "Contents of downloaded artifact:"
          cat downloaded/build.txt

name: Build and Consume Artifact

on:
  push:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Produce build output
        run: |
          mkdir -p dist
          echo "build ${{ github.sha }}" > dist/build.txt

      - name: Upload build artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: build-output
          path: dist/
          if-no-files-found: error

  consume:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Download build artifact
        uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8.0.1
        with:
          name: build-output
          path: downloaded/

      - name: Use the downloaded artifact
        run: |
          echo "Contents of downloaded artifact:"
          cat downloaded/build.txt
